question: Who became the new CEO of NetBrain in 2026?

hits.title: NetBrain appoints three new executives to help customers chart their path to Agentic NetOps.
hits.snippet: BURLINGTON, Mass., June 30, 2026 - NetBrain Technologies, the pioneer of Agentic NetOps, today announced three executive appointments: Luvlynn Lee as Chief Customer Officer (CCO), Sean Dolan as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), and Scott Fitzgerald as Chief Marketing Officer (CMO).

hits.title: NetBrain achieves Infoblox certification to advance real-time netops.
hits.snippet: Network automation and AI specialist NetBrain has become a certified Infoblox partner for real-time netops.

hits.title: NetBrain builds out agentic AI operations capabilities: AutoCon 5 preview.
hits.snippet: NetBrain now integrates with Dynatrace, an Application Performance Monitoring (APM) platform, to map dependencies between the network and critical applications.

hits.title: Meet NetBrain: ALLIANCE Distribution signs distribution agreement with the leader in agentic netops.
hits.snippet: ALLIANCE Distribution announces the signing of a distribution agreement with NetBrain, a leading vendor in AI-powered network operations automation that helps enterprises prevent outages and ensure the seamless operation of network infrastructure.

hits.title: Magna5 announces executive leadership changes.
hits.snippet: Prior to Magna5, Masseur served as vice president of sales and partner programs at NetBrain, a leading network automation vendor.

hits.title: From Network Automation to Agentic NetOps: NetBrain sets the standard for deploying AI in network operations.
hits.snippet: BURLINGTON, Mass. - NetBrain Technologies, Inc. today announced major new platform features that advance Agentic NetOps from an emerging category to operational reality.

hits.title: Maxtec QBS and NetBrain announce strategic partnership for Africa.
hits.snippet: NetBrain, which positions itself as a leading network automation platform leveraging AI-driven digital twin and no-code automation, has partnered with Maxtec QBS Software Africa, a QBS Technology Group company, to transform network operations across Africa.
